nutritionRules.title: Nutrition assessment thresholds
nutritionRules.description: Default thresholds for the green / yellow / red rating rules for people with atrial fibrillation. A rule applies to a patient only when the doctor ticks it in the diet prescription; doctors can set custom thresholds. Thresholds are stored in the database and changes here take effect immediately.
nutritionRules.footer: "Exceeds" is compared per 100 g of edible portion. Color merging: any red rule makes it red; no red but some yellow makes it yellow; no negative points and at least one positive point (low Na/K, or magnesium-rich with little salt) makes it green. The Na/K ratio is red only when sodium also exceeds the salt red threshold; the magnesium point only counts when sodium does not exceed the salt yellow threshold. Leaving a field empty means the rule has no such level. Custom thresholds a doctor sets for a patient always take precedence over the defaults here.

toast.saved: Thresholds saved. Food colors are now calculated using the new thresholds.
